title: Turn features on and off
description: One click turns a module on or off on this server. A disabled module’s commands don’t run — members get a friendly message instead. The sub-modules (underworld, bitcoin, stocks) stop together with Economy.
onText: The bot will pick it up within a few seconds.
offText: The module’s commands won’t run on this server.
blocked: Not running because {parent} is turned off.
aiLocked: On this server, AI features can only be allowed by the OrangenBot operator.
